reference_probe.note: Reference source text, private repository identifiers and original paths are excluded; equivalent synthetic fixtures are versioned in the source/CLI tests.

coverage: Explicit field/status maps preserve original vocabulary and exact relationship pointers
Mapping conflicts and invalid canonical redefinitions fail; unknown values remain diagnostic
Mapped YAML claim/progress writeback and stale mapping rejection
Chinese ADR metadata, bullet/bold/full-width syntax, equivalent bilingual declarations and conflicts
Public JSON/YAML authentication/schema definitions, hidden values and duplicate-key concealment
Full input validation before display-summary truncation; no false incomplete context for public definitions
Old FTS caches and source parsing configurations are invalidated by policy/version changes
Doctor shares the exact profile/options/parser-version identity with indexing and mutations; real configuration changes remain diagnostic until reindex.
Proposal configuration-drift fixture uses a valid status map; obsolete unsupported options are rejected by manifest validation, while actual valid mapping changes still produce SourceConflict.
limitations: Local programmatic integration evidence, not E4 or release acceptance.
No original reference project files or runtime state were modified.
Mappings cover supported ledger fields; arbitrary root schema transformations and Markdown writes are outside this change.
Secret detection covers declared shapes/labels, not arbitrary unlabelled private text.
Test command counts overlap and are not summed as unique coverage.

findings: Doctor duplicated a stale configuration shape and reported unchanged minimal-profile sources as changed; now uses shared source_configuration.
CLI/MCP parity expected the pre-organization top-level status error; assertions now verify the structured error, non-ready organization and unknown total without relaxing SourceStale.
